title: elaphoglossum durum
intro: Elaphoglossum durum, commonly known as the Durum Elaphoglossum, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Elaphoglossum durum include its ability to calm the nervous system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential treatment for various health issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
